checks.text: The right code finishes the delivery
The delivered order is off the rider list
A photo of the parcel can finish a delivery when the buyer has no code

shots.caption: The buyer code and the money taken, typed by the rider
The rider list: the finished delivery is gone
Finished with a photo of the parcel instead of the code

did: The buyer told the rider the code. The rider typed it with the money taken and pressed "Delivered" on the Gulshan order. For the Mirpur order the rider attached a photo of the parcel instead.
